items.title: Amos White Interview, 1958-08-23
items.q: My mother's maiden name was Elizabeth Burgess and she was married to Louis White.

ctx.x: I was christened by Friday Montgomery Methodist preacher Amos Earl Mordecai White. Amos was all right. The Mordecai was quite complicated because the people in my early life used to call me Mordecai instead of Mordecai as it is properly pronounced. November 6, 1889 was given in the Bible as my date of birth. It was so registered in the county seat, Williamsburg, King Street, South Carolina. My mother's maiden name was Elizabeth Burgess and she was married to Louis White. The date of that I do not know. However,…
and that time I had come back home. How old an institution is the Jenkins orphanage?
